title: Object Impermanence
description: If you stop looking at something, it might disappear.
body:
In the boring real world, things stay where you left them, and don't go away unless something moves them. Sadly, Minecraft (and many other games) never even think to break out of this normal world to add an extremely confusing and creepy game mechanic. (Weird, I know.) But good news! With this datapack, looking away from something means that it is no longer fixed in place. It can move, be split in half, or even disappear altogether.

Have fun!
